title: Which AI Use Cases Deserve a Pilot? A Risk and Value Framework for Funding, Scoping, and Scaling AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.20894v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A composite score can rank AI use cases while leaving the permitted operating scope and the evidence required for expansion unspecified. We treat the unit of decision as a use case at a proposed scope (authority, human mediation, limits, volume, environment, population) and define three decisions: screen the scope, fund the experiment, and authorize expansion only when residual risk is acceptable and evidence of incremental net value applies at that scope. A risk track (R1-R4) is implemented as an explicit decision table with vetoes and documented precedence, and a value track follows four evidence stages with each transition needing its own evidence. Funding uses expected value of perfect information as an upper bound and the value of sample information for the specific experiment. A quantified expected-loss check, required where policy says so, computes the containment an expansion needs and credits a control only on evidence measured

translated_title: 哪些AI用例值得试点？一个用于资助、界定范围与扩展AI的风险与价值框架
translated_abstract: 综合评分可以对AI用例进行排序，但允许的运行范围以及扩展所需的证据却未予明确。我们将决策单元视为处于拟议范围内的一个用例（包括权限、人工介入程度、限制条件、业务量、环境与适用人群），并定义了三项决策：筛选范围、资助实验，以及仅在剩余风险可接受且增量净价值的证据在该范围内成立时才授权扩展。风险轨道（R1-R4）以明确的决策表形式实现，包含否决项和记录在案的优先级规则；价值轨道则遵循四个证据阶段，每次阶段过渡都需要其专属的证据。资助决策以完美信息的期望价值作为上限，并以针对具体实验的样本信息价值作为依据。在政策要求之处，还需进行量化的预期损失检查，以计算扩展所需的遏制措施，且控制措施只有在有实测证据支持时才会被认可。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个以“特定拟议范围内的AI用例”为决策单元的风险与价值双轨框架，通过R1-R4风险决策表（含否决项与优先级规则）和四阶段价值证据流程，指导AI用例的范围筛选、试点资助与扩展授权决策，确保扩展仅在剩余风险可接受且增量净价值证据充分时获批。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a dual-track risk and value framework that treats an AI use case at a proposed scope as the decision unit, combining an explicit risk decision table (R1-R4) with four value-evidence stages to guide scope screening, pilot funding, and scaling authorization, ensuring expansion is approved only when residual risk is acceptable and incremental net value evidence applies at that scope.
